experiment.description: The memory writer as a separate principal. At levels 3 and 4 the current retrieval slice is conversation only, so some conclusions are not derivable from what is retrievable. summary_with_inferences stores only derivable conclusions; summary_with_global_inferences stores every conclusion the writer could reach from the full history. The difference is leakage caused by the memory writer, not by the answering model. F withholds unsupported memory conclusions; A, D and E do not.
